batches.name: Ridgewood and Glendale (Deanery Q11)
batches.why: Four neighbouring parishes in Deanery Q11, no shared pastor named in the priests' directory. A typical batch: St. Matthias embeds ParishesOnline (po-org st-matthias-church-11385); the others are on the diocese's Tilma sites.

batches.name: Jackson Heights and East Elmhurst (Q3)
batches.why: Deanery Q3, north half. Separate pastors per the priests' directory. joanofarcqueens.org redirects off-site (probe url REDIRECT-OFFSITE, 2026-11-05): check where it goes.

batches.name: Corona and Elmhurst (Q3)
batches.why: Deanery Q3, south half. GCatholic's Our Lady of Mount Carmel, Corona (103-56 52nd Ave) is placed here; settle whether it still has Mass and under which parish.

batches.name: Whitestone, College Point and north Flushing (Q4)
batches.why: Deanery Q4, north. St. Fidelis embeds ParishesOnline (po-org st-fidelis-church).

batches.name: Flushing (Q4)
batches.why: Deanery Q4, Flushing parishes with large Korean and Chinese communities; check each publishes its own bulletin and which language editions exist.

batches.name: Mary's Nativity-St. Ann, St. Andrew Avellino and St. Kevin
batches.why: South and east Flushing (Q4 and Q5). Mary's Nativity-St. Ann is a merged parish: GCatholic still lists St. Ann (142-30 58th Ave) as a church; check it still has Mass.

batches.name: American Martyrs, Holy Family and St. Robert Bellarmine
batches.why: Very Rev. Sean M. Suckiel is Pastor of both American Martyrs, Bayside and Holy Family, Fresh Meadows (priests' directory, read 2026-11-05): check for one shared bulletin. St. Robert Bellarmine is the neighbouring Q5 parish.

batches.name: Bayside (Q5)
batches.why: Deanery Q5, Bayside. Separate pastors per the priests' directory.

batches.name: Douglaston, Bellerose and Floral Park (Q5)
batches.why: Eastern edge of Queens, Deanery Q5. The deanery list also carries the Immaculate Conception Center (7200 Douglaston Pkwy), the diocesan pastoral center: find whether its chapel has public Mass (GCatholic puts the Syro-Malankara St. Basil at the same address; that one is in the eastern batch).

batches.name: Resurrection-Ascension, Our Lady of the Angelus, Ascension and St. Adalbert
batches.why: Resurrection-Ascension and Our Lady of the Angelus were merged by decree (dioceseofbrooklyn.org, posted 2025-09-10, effective 2023-01-01, 'two churches for worship'), yet the directory lists them separately: likely one bulletin. GCatholic's Our Lady of China chapel (Elmhurst) is placed here.

batches.name: Middle Village and Glendale (Q6)
batches.why: Deanery Q6, west. GCatholic's St. John chapel at 80-01 Metropolitan Ave (St. John Cemetery) is placed here; settle whether it has public Mass.

batches.name: Forest Hills and Kew Gardens Hills
batches.why: Q6 Forest Hills parishes and Queen of Peace (Q7) next to them. The directory gives Our Lady Queen of Martyrs no website.

batches.name: Queens Village (Q7)
batches.why: Incarnation-St. Gerard Majella was merged by decree (posted 2024-12-23, 'two churches for worship': Incarnation and St. Gerard Majella, Hollis). The Mass finder puts Our Lady of Lourdes' coordinates in Bushwick (its chapel namesake); use the parish's own address.

batches.name: Jamaica and Richmond Hill (Q7)
batches.why: Deanery Q7 around Jamaica. Separate pastors per the priests' directory.

batches.name: OLPH, St. Teresa of Avila-St. Anthony of Padua and St. Mary Gate of Heaven
batches.why: Very Rev. Thomas W. Ahern is 'Pastor, Our Lady of Perpetual Help, South Ozone Park and St. Teresa of Avila - St. Anthony of Padua, South Ozone Park' (priests' directory, 2026-11-05): check for one shared bulletin. GCatholic still lists St. Anthony of Padua (133-25 128th St) as its own church.

batches.name: Ozone Park, Woodhaven and Richmond Hill (Q8)
batches.why: Deanery Q8, north. Two merged parishes; GCatholic still lists St. Benedict Joseph Labre (94-40 118th St) as a church.

batches.name: Howard Beach (Q8)
batches.why: The two Howard Beach parishes, Deanery Q8. Separate pastors per the priests' directory.

batches.name: Rosedale and Springfield Gardens (Q9)
batches.why: Very Rev. Daniel O. Kingsley is Pastor of both St. Clare and St. Pius X, Rosedale; Christ the King and St. Mary Magdalene were merged by decree effective 2024-07-01 ('two churches for worship') yet are listed separately in the directory. Expect at most two bulletins.

batches.name: South Jamaica (Q9)
batches.why: Deanery Q9, Jamaica parishes. Separate pastors per the priests' directory.

batches.name: St. Albans, Cambria Heights and the JFK chapel
batches.why: Our Lady of Light is a merged parish; GCatholic still lists St. Catherine of Siena and St. Pascal Baylon (St. Albans) as churches. Our Lady of the Skies is the JFK Terminal 4 chapel (jfkchapel.org): decide whether it publishes anything.

batches.name: Breezy Point, Belle Harbor and Rockaway Park
batches.why: Western Rockaways, Deanery Q10. GCatholic lists St. Edmund and St. Genevieve (Breezy Point) and St. Virgilius (Broad Channel) as churches: summer chapels or closed? Check the bulletins.

batches.name: Rockaway Beach and Far Rockaway
batches.why: Eastern Rockaways. Very Rev. Francis T. Shannon is 'Pastor, St. Mary Star of the Sea and St. Gertrude, Far Rockaway'; the Mass finder lists St. Gertrude's church separately.

batches.name: Maspeth
batches.why: The two Maspeth parishes, Deanery Q11.

batches.name: Long Island City (Q1)
batches.why: Rev. Felix Sanchez is 'Pastor, St. Rita, Long Island City & St. Patrick, Long Island City' (priests' directory, 2026-11-05): check for one shared bulletin. The directory gives Most Precious Blood no website.

batches.name: Astoria (Q1)
batches.why: Deanery Q1, Astoria. The deanery page lists Immaculate Conception, Jamaica under Q1 where Astoria's would be expected.

batches.name: St. Raphael, St. Teresa and Queen of Angels
batches.why: Rev. Richard W. Conlon is Pastor of both St. Raphael, Long Island City and St. Teresa, Woodside: check for one shared bulletin. Queen of Angels, Sunnyside is between them.

batches.name: St. Sebastian-Corpus Christi and St. Mary's of Winfield
batches.why: Woodside, Deanery Q2. The deanery list and Mass finder still list Corpus Christi (31-30 61st St) on its own; the directory has the merged St. Sebastian-Corpus Christi.

batches.name: Brooklyn Heights and Downtown
batches.why: Very Rev. Joseph R. Gibino is Pastor of St. Charles Borromeo and Administrator of the Cathedral Basilica of St. James: check for one shared bulletin. The directory gives Assumption the phone 718-875-2096, which the deanery list gives to St. Boniface.

batches.name: Carroll Gardens, Cobble Hill and Red Hook
batches.why: Rev. Msgr. Guy A. Massie is Pastor of Sacred Hearts & St. Stephen and Administrator of St. Mary Star of the Sea, Carroll Gardens: check for one shared bulletin. St. Paul & St. Agnes keeps two churches (St. Agnes, 433 Sackett St).

batches.name: Park Slope and Gowanus
batches.why: Deanery B4, north. St. Augustine-St. Francis Xavier was merged by decree effective 2024-07-01 ('two churches for worship'). GCatholic's Melkite Virgin Mary (216 8th Ave) is in the eastern batch.

batches.name: South Slope, Windsor Terrace and Kensington
batches.why: Deanery B4, south. Two merged parishes; GCatholic still lists St. Rocco (216 27th St) as a church.

batches.name: Sunset Park
batches.why: Very Rev. Fulgencio Gutierrez is Pastor of both St. Michael and St. Agatha, Sunset Park: check for one shared bulletin. The deanery page's B8 list wrongly gives St. Michael-St. Malachy (East New York) and OLPH, South Ozone Park instead of these two.

batches.name: Borough Park and Kensington
batches.why: Deanery B8, Borough Park. The Mass finder's St. Rose of Lima page shows sample-looking times (a 'potluck brunch' note): don't trust it.

batches.name: Dyker Heights
batches.why: Dyker Heights and its edges (B8, B9). The Regina Pacis parish is St. Rosalia-Regina Pacis (priests' directory): check whether St. Rosalia still has Mass.

batches.name: Our Lady of Angels, St. Andrew, St. Anselm and St. Patrick
batches.why: Rev. Kevin P. Abels is 'Pastor, Our Lady of Angels, St. Andrew the Apostle, St. Anselm, Bay Ridge' (priests' directory, 2026-11-05): likely one bulletin for three. St. Patrick is the fourth Bay Ridge parish. GCatholic's Visitation Monastery (8902 Ridge Blvd) is placed here.

batches.name: St. Frances Cabrini, St. Bernadette and St. Finbar
batches.why: Rev. Jeremy A.L. Canna is 'Pastor, St. Bernadette, Dyker Heights and St. Frances Cabrini, Brooklyn'; Guardian Angel's 2026-11-08 bulletin names 'St. Finbarr and St. Frances Cabrini' together among its deanery neighbours. Settle which of the three share a bulletin.

batches.name: Bensonhurst and Gravesend
batches.why: Deanery B10, merged parishes: GCatholic still lists St. Dominic and Sts. Simon and Jude as churches. The directory gives Most Precious Blood-Ss. Simon and Jude no website.

batches.name: Coney Island, Brighton and Gravesend
batches.why: Southern Brooklyn, Deanery B10. Guardian Angel's bulletin is a Tilma PDF (files.tilmaplatform.com, 2026-11-08 issue read).

batches.name: St. Brendan, St. Edmund and St. Mark-St. Margaret Mary
batches.why: Rev. Lukasz P. Trocha is Pastor of St. Edmund, Homecrest and Administrator of St. Brendan, Midwood: check for one shared bulletin. St. Mark-St. Margaret Mary is the neighbouring merged parish.

batches.name: St. Thomas Aquinas, Our Lady Help of Christians and St. Vincent Ferrer
batches.why: Very Rev. Dwayne D. Davis is Pastor of St. Thomas Aquinas, Flatlands and Administrator of Our Lady Help of Christians, Midwood: check for one shared bulletin.

batches.name: Marine Park, Gerritsen Beach and Mill Basin
batches.why: The directory lists both Good Shepherd-Resurrection (1950 Batchelder St) and Resurrection (2331 Gerritsen Ave); the deanery list and Mass finder still list Mary Queen of Heaven separately from the merged Mary Queen of Heaven-St. Bernard. Expect fewer bulletins than entries.

batches.name: Flatbush
batches.why: Deanery B7, west. Our Lady of Refuge-Holy Innocents is merged; the deanery list and Mass finder still list Our Lady of Refuge alone and the Mass finder lists Holy Innocents.

batches.name: East Flatbush and Canarsie
batches.why: Deanery B7, east. Holy Family-St. Laurence is merged; GCatholic still lists St. Laurence (1020 Van Siclen Ave) as a church.

batches.name: East New York and Cypress Hills
batches.why: Deanery B6, north. Blessed Sacrament-St. Sylvester keeps two phone lines in the directory: check whether both churches still have Mass.

batches.name: Brownsville, Ocean Hill and Spring Creek
batches.why: Deanery B6, south. Merged parishes with closures: Mary Mother of the Church is St. John Cantius + St. Gabriel (2007, archives list); OL Presentation-OL Mercy kept OL Mercy's church (680 Mother Gaston Blvd). GCatholic still lists St. John Cantius and Holy Rosary nearby.

batches.name: Greenpoint
batches.why: Deanery B1, Greenpoint. The archives list says Holy Family, Greenpoint merged with St. Anthony-St. Alphonsus in 2011; GCatholic still lists Holy Family (21 Nassau Ave) and St. Cecilia (84 Herbert St, merged into Divine Mercy).

batches.name: Williamsburg
batches.why: Deanery B1, south Williamsburg. SS. Peter & Paul-Epiphany: GCatholic lists Sts. Peter and Paul (71 S 3rd St) and Epiphany (96 S 9th St); the Mass finder gives 288 Berry St. Settle which buildings have Mass.

batches.name: East Williamsburg and North Williamsburg
batches.why: Merged parishes with many old churches: Divine Mercy is St. Cecilia, St. Nicholas and St. Francis of Paola (2011); OLMC-Annunciation keeps the OLMC shrine and Annunciation (259 N 5th St). Expect closures; the GCatholic leftovers are placed here.

batches.name: Mary of Nazareth, All Saints and St. John the Baptist
batches.why: Deanery B2, west. Merged parishes: Mary of Nazareth (Sacred Heart, St. Michael-St. Edward, 2008); All Saints-OL of the Rosary of Pompeii (GCatholic still lists Pompeii, 225 Siegel St); St. John the Baptist absorbed OL of Good Counsel (2007). GCatholic's St. Lucy-St. Patrick is placed here.

batches.name: Bushwick
batches.why: Deanery B2, Bushwick. St. Martin of Tours absorbed Our Lady of Lourdes (2007): GCatholic and the Mass finder each list an Our Lady of Lourdes chapel (1288 Hancock St; 89 Furman Ave). Settle which is real.

batches.name: Co-Cathedral, Queen of All Saints and St. Martin de Porres
batches.why: Deanery B5. Co-Cathedral of St. Joseph-St. Teresa of Avila keeps St. Teresa (563 Sterling Pl; the Mass finder's 'St. Teresa' at 777 Classon Ave). St. Martin de Porres merged Holy Rosary, OL of Victory and St. Peter Claver (2007): GCatholic lists all three; the Mass finder gives St. Martin de Porres a Floral Park address. A closures batch.

batches.name: Crown Heights
batches.why: Deanery B5, Crown Heights. St. Matthew absorbed OL of Charity (2011, archives list); GCatholic still lists St. Ignatius (1101 Carroll St) and St. Gregory the Great (224 Brooklyn Ave), placed here by location: settle which parish, if any, has Mass there.

batches.name: Eastern Catholic and Coptic churches in the territory
batches.why: GCatholic lists these Ukrainian, Melkite, Syro-Malankara, Armenian, Romanian and Coptic churches inside the diocese. They belong to eparchies, not to Brooklyn: expect other-jurisdiction exclusions, each with a source. St. Ann (Armenian) shares its address with the Latin St. Ann, Flushing; St. Basil (Syro-Malankara) shares the Immaculate Conception Center's.

excluded.reason: Not a parish: the deanery page lists the diocesan offices (310 Prospect Park West) under Q10.
